belgian_pro_league.name: Belgian Pro League
belgian_pro_league.text: Recent Belgian Pro League results included draws as OH Leuven drew 2-2 with Lommel SK and KVC Westerlo drew 4-4 with Waasland-Beveren. The biggest margin was KAA Gent's 4-0 win over Anderlecht, matching the 3-0 wins for Antwerp over Royal Charleroi SC and RAAL La Louvière over Zulte-Waregem. Other results saw Union St.-Gilloise beat Cercle Brugge KSV 5-2, Club Brugge win 3-2 against Sint-Truidense and 4-2 at Zulte-Waregem, and Racing Genk defeat Standard Liege 2-1.

bundesliga.name: Bundesliga
bundesliga.text: RB Leipzig's 4-0 win over SV 07 Elversberg was the biggest margin of the recent Bundesliga results. 1. FC Köln and FC Schalke 04 played out a 0-0 draw, while FC Augsburg and 1. FC Union Berlin drew 1-1.

eredivisie.name: Eredivisie
eredivisie.text: Willem II's 1-6 defeat to SC Cambuur was the biggest margin of the recent Eredivisie round. There were draws between FC Utrecht and PEC Zwolle, NEC Nijmegen and FC Groningen, and PSV Eindhoven and Feyenoord Rotterdam.

la_liga.name: La Liga
la_liga.text: Athletic Club's 4-0 win over Getafe CF was the biggest margin in the recent La Liga results. The only draw was RC Celta de Vigo 0-0 Real Betis Balompié. Other results included Real Madrid CF beating FC Barcelona 2-1 and Sevilla FC defeating CA Osasuna 2-0.

ligue_1.name: Ligue 1
ligue_1.text: Recent Ligue 1 results included draws between Monaco and Lille, Angers and Lorient, Auxerre and Le Mans, and Toulouse and Troyes. The biggest margin was Paris Saint-Germain's 5-1 win over Le Havre, while Nice also beat Rennes 5-2.

premier_league.name: Premier League
premier_league.text: Manchester United's 0-3 defeat to AFC Bournemouth was the biggest margin of the recent Premier League results. Hull City and Brentford drew 1-1, while Sunderland and Leeds United played out a 0-0 draw.

primeira_liga.name: Primeira Liga
primeira_liga.text: In the recent Primeira Liga results, Rio Ave's 0-4 defeat to FC Famalicao was the biggest margin. There were no draws across the listed matches.

serie_a.name: Serie A
serie_a.text: Lazio's 6-2 win at Sassuolo was the biggest margin of the recent Serie A results. There were also draws: Napoli 3-3 Roma, Atalanta 4-4 Frosinone, Parma 0-0 Udinese and Fiorentina 2-2 Atalanta.

super_lig.name: Süper Lig
super_lig.text: Recent Süper Lig results saw Konyaspor beat Genclerbirligi 2-0 before falling 0-4 to Galatasaray, the biggest margin of the listed matches. Goztepe, Besiktas and Kasimpasa each won without conceding, while Caykur Rizespor lost 3-4 to Trabzonspor and Galatasaray edged Fenerbahce 2-1. There were no draws in these results.
